dispatch.how: A dispatch is a GitHub issue spec routed via the orchestration surfaces to a provider lane; the provider authors a monorepo PR naming provider + session id; sub-manager verifies (provenance first); desk tracks merge on merge-clear and artifact sync. This page mutates nothing. Instance stamp is part of the dispatch record (DoE configured-instance identity, PR #2656): every dispatch carries provider + session_id + model@version verbatim + system_prompt_ref + tools_ref (ref scheme: repo path or prompt:<moniker>:<slug> / tools:<moniker>:<slug>, always with the SHA-256 of the exact dispatched content; compact stamp <ref>#<sha256[:12]>; instance_key via scripts/doe/instance_key.py). No stamp => no dispatch (telemetry gate, 2026-10-30 23:10 PT).

provider_catalog.note: COMPLETE catalog (owner order 2026-11-01, fix seat 5f3a3217): provider_lanes = every dispatch-capable surface in the Provider Index, honestly classed. Classes: proven = triggered and completed with cited evidence; wired-unproven = wired in-repo, no successful run yet (gets bounded proof dispatches, not production-critical work); triggerable = a live trigger exists (dispatch/schedule/event) but the surface is support-class or never fired; inference-only = registry model records reachable only through a named dispatch arm (provider-batch / provider-availability / openrouter probe) until a proof dispatch promotes them.

rotation_rule.rule: Bench-wide: no provider takes 2 consecutive dispatches for the same entry, across ALL catalog lanes (supersedes the 2026-10-31 rule, which capped repeats inside the 4-lane funnel only).
rotation_rule.selection: Task-fit across the full catalog: (1) match task class to lanes; (2) proven lanes carry production work; (3) wired-unproven / triggerable surfaces receive bounded, DoE-stamped proof dispatches instead of permanent exile — a first success promotes them to proven at the next feed refresh; (4) inference-only registry providers are selectable for inference/eval tasks via their named dispatch arm, stamped with provider + model@version; (5) every dispatch stamps provider + surface + selection reason + session/run id (telemetry gate: no stamp => no dispatch).
rotation_rule.reselection_d1: D1 pending dispatches re-selected under the widened bench (fix seat review 2026-11-01): DeepSeek fix-pass (deepseek-termux-agent run 41301295882, success) and Gemini SR module (issue #3050, gemini-dispatch run 41301369671, success) STAND — two distinct providers, rotation-valid, both already fired. The NEXT D1 dispatch must go to a proven lane outside {DeepSeek, Gemini} for its task class (fix: CodeRabbit / Devin / command-dispatch / Jules; feature: Jules / DeepAgent-task), stamped with the reason.
